verdicts.note: Attacked toward 0/+1 (never held the elected office, open seat, lost a 2022 run per S6). But six years inside the Clerk's Office up to chief deputy plus six in county accounts payable (S1, S3) is an insider proven-record profile; -1 rather than -2 already reflects no tenure as clerk. Citations S1, S3, S6 support the basis.

Attacked as generic campaign language. The pledge to 'carefully manage the Clerk's budget' and run the office 'efficiently, transparently, and responsibly on behalf of taxpayers' (S3, S4) is a single clear restraint statement, with no expansion proposals anywhere in the dossier; -1 medium fits. Not -2: no audit or cut proposals.

About 20 years in county court-services administration and AOC liaison work (S1, S5), but never in the Clerk's Office or elected office, so -1 rather than -2. Same placement as Butler is defensible: both are county insiders running for an open seat. Citations S1, S5 support it.
